text:
Noah: FYI ArborIQ disputed INV-2026-05-03. They argue committed units were applied to a fallback model after regional maintenance and say burst charges are incorrect. Asking for proration or refund.

Rita: Can someone pull the commit attribution for May 2-3 23:50-00:20 UTC? Customer says the traffic should have been routed to their reserved pool, not transient fallback.

Dave: pulling logs now. early observation: routing policy fell back to shared-hosted due to a mis-tagged node during maintenance window. Looks like committed allocation was not honored for ~18 minutes.

Dave: snippet: ```pool_assignments:
2026-05-03T00:02Z -> shared-hosted (should have been arboriq-dedicated-1)
2026-05-03T00:10Z -> arboriq-dedicated-1
```

Noah: so that 18m of requests were billed at burst rates. Estimated extra burst = $8,150. ArborIQ wants a cash refund rather than a credit to next invoice.

Finance-bot: Policy: cash refunds for billing disputes > $5k require finance director + legal approval. Credits preferred for recurring customers.

Rita: ArborIQ is year-long committed customer, good NPS, they've escalated to their CFO asking for refund. Recommend offering a refund for the exact overcharged amount plus 5% goodwill. Need sam signoff and legal confirmation.

Sam: I can sign off on the refund amount up to $10k if legal clears contract terms re: billing remedies. @legal-bot please check SLA clause for cash refund eligibility.

Legal-bot: Review complete. Contract SOW section 4.2 allows billing remedy "credit or refund" for unfulfilled committed capacity. No prohibition on refunds. Recommend documenting remediation and a short amendment note.

Dave: engineering fix: adjust routing priority so reserved pools are pinned during maintenance, deploying patch now. ETA 3h. We'll also add an event log flag to make future reconciliations easier.

Noah: action items: 1) Calculate exact overage by charge id, 2) prepare refund memo, 3) get sam + legal signoff, 4) issue refund and notify customer.

Rita: charge ids: CHG-11221, CHG-11222. Worksheet in ticket #4182 with per-minute breakdown. Overcharge amount = $8,150. Goodwill 5% = $407.50. Total refund = $8,557.50.

Sam: Approved. Legal acked. Proceed with cash refund of $8,557.50 and attach remediation note.

Finance-bot: To process refund, run: `/process-refund CHG-11221,CHG-11222 amount=8557.50 ticket=4182` and include memo. This action will pause invoice auto-pay for this customer until processed.

Noah: I'll run the command and send the customer note: factual, include remediation steps and apology. Closing ticket #4182 after refund clears.

Rita: Thanks everyone. Please add a follow-up in eng-retro for improved test sim of maintenance routing. :calendar:
